title: 第3章 并州印信第4章 铁匠
slug: 北侯世子反派的我背景逆天
lines: “柳小姐。”
裴苏侧头，向一旁的柳芷举杯。
她惊喜地叫了一声，连忙举起蓝釉杯，与裴苏碰了一碰。
一杯见底，柳芷已然面色潮红，不知是不胜酒力还是别的什么。
“柳小姐倒是酒力不行……”
裴苏打趣一声，柳芷面色更红，烧到耳根，嗫嚅着：“……嗯……”
裴苏脸上依旧含笑，眸光却隐秘一转，扫向了门口处把守的那名侍卫。
可恶！
柳妹还从没跟一个男子靠得这么近！
赵岚站在门口，看似守卫，目光却不断暗暗地扫过正堂中的席位。
准确的说，是集中在中央桌上，柳氏之女柳芷的身上。
瞧见他暗地钦慕的柳妹与一个陌生男子如此亲近交流，他心底莫名冒起火气。
目光在扫过那玄色蟒袍男子的时候，闪烁几分的不善。
除了因为柳芷之外，还有几分他不愿承认的妒忌。
北侯世子，裴九牧，这位名动天下的天骄人物，他自然是听过的。
以前只觉遥远，未曾放在心上，但亲眼瞧见的时候，他不自觉比较起来。
而这一比，让他陷入无地自容的境地。
论实力，听说北侯世子已然修成玄元圆满，而他不过刚刚修成玄元。
更令他无地自容的是，裴苏今年不过十九，他已经二十有六，其中差距，真正修行之人才知晓，不啻天壤。
而论相貌，赵岚更是没法比，不得不承认裴苏那张脸得了老天钟爱，俊秀无暇。
至于身份地位……
饶是赵岚向来不要脸，此刻也不禁脸红，人家京城顶级世家长子，父亲乃威震朝野的镇北王侯。
而自己不过是个无父无母的孤儿，只有一个铁匠养父，若非修行有成，连州府大门都进不了。
赵岚暗暗咬牙，心胸堵着一口郁气。
若那世子对柳妹有意，自己如何竞争得过？！
不……柳妹不是那么肤浅的人，只要我一直对她好，她肯定会感动的……
什么世子王侯，如何能比得上我一颗赤子真心！
想到这里，赵岚才全身轻松了些。
是啊！
世间恋情，得讲究你情我愿。
他赵岚别的没有，唯有能为爱人赴汤蹈火、誓死不悔的决心！
“世子殿下！其实，其实我父亲也并非不想练箭……”

"Miss Liu."
Pei Su turned his head and raised his glass to Liu Zhi beside him.
She screamed in surprise, quickly raised the blue glaze cup, and touched it with Pei Su.
After the glass was gone, Liu Zhi's face was already flushed. She didn't know whether it was because she was too drunk or something else.
"Miss Liu is not strong enough to drink..."
Pei Su made a funny sound, and Liu Zhi's face turned even redder, burning to the base of her ears, and murmured: "...Hmm..."
Pei Su still had a smile on his face, but his eyes secretly turned and glanced at the guard guarding the door.
…
Damn it!
Liu Mei has never been so close to a man!
Zhao Lan stood at the door, seemingly a guard, but his eyes kept secretly scanning the seats in the main hall.
To be precise, it was concentrated on the central table, Liu Zhi, the daughter of the Liu family.
Seeing Liu Mei, whom he secretly admired, communicating so closely with a strange man, he felt inexplicably angry.
When his eyes glanced at the man in black python robe, there was a hint of evil.
In addition to Liu Zhi, there was also a bit of jealousy that he didn't want to admit.
He had naturally heard of Pei Jiumu, the prince of the Northern Marquis, who was famous all over the world.
In the past, he only felt it was far away and never paid much attention to it, but when he saw it with his own eyes, he couldn't help but compare it.
And this comparison put him in a position of shame.
In terms of strength, I heard that the Prince of Beihou had already reached Xuanyuan Perfection, but he had only just reached Xuanyuan.
What makes him even more ashamed is that Pei Su is only nineteen this year, while he is already sixty-six in his twenties. Only those who are true practitioners will know that the difference is huge.
As for appearance, Zhao Lan is even more incomparable. She has to admit that Pei Su's face is loved by God and is so handsome and flawless.
As for status...
Even though Zhao Lan had always been shameless, he couldn't help but blush at this moment. He was the eldest son of a top family in the capital, and his father was the prince of Zhenbei, who was powerful in both the government and the public.
And he is just an orphan without a father and a mother. He only has a blacksmith as his adoptive father. If he is not successful in spiritual practice, he cannot even enter the gate of the state capital.
Zhao Lan secretly gritted his teeth, feeling depressed in his chest.
If that prince was interested in Liu Mei, how could he compete with her? !
No...Liu Mei is not such a superficial person. As long as I always treat her well, she will definitely be moved...
How can any prince or prince compare to my pure sincerity!
Thinking of this, Zhao Lan felt a little more relaxed.
yes!
Love in this world must pay attention to your love and my willingness.
He, Zhao Lan, has nothing else but his determination to go through fire and water for his lover and never regret it!
…
"His Royal Highness! Actually, it's not that my father doesn't want to practice archery..."
